title: Vascularity guide, or how to get veiny
summary: NH says there is no magic exercise or supplement for veins. Lasting vascularity comes from growing muscle, since bigger muscles demand more blood and the veins around them enlarge, combined with moderate leanness rather than crash cuts. He adds that garlic and cold exposure seemed to help him.
claims: Magic exercises or supplements for veins are scams sold because vascularity is desirable, like six-pack products
You need to be fairly lean to be veiny, but not below 10% body fat; veins can show through some fat
Carb-ups or high sodium only highlight existing veins temporarily, not a long-term solution
Muscles are vascularised because they demand lots of oxygen and nutrients; veins that pop already existed and simply grew bigger
Avoid aggressive cuts just to see veins; they sacrifice muscle and therefore long-term vascularity
The real solution is getting bigger: as a muscle grows, the body enlarges the veins around it
His biggest and most trained muscles have the most veins; he got biceps veins just by training biceps hard
After he started training lats intensely they grew and veins appeared around them; same with shoulders
Training makes the body more anabolic, which promotes veins that feed further muscle growth, in a cycle
Fat needs little blood flow and covers veins, so balance size gains with leanness and avoid both dirty bulking and extreme dieting
Long-term garlic consumption has helped his vascularity
Cold showers or cold environments promote capillary formation throughout the body
